decisions.reason: As a minimum quantity lubrication system close to the firm's established fluid-handling offer, it leverages existing absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback and improve, making dropping unlikely.
The hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on established filtration know-how, so the firm can assimilate early results and apply refinements, supporting retention.
The gravity band coolant filter is close to the firm's existing product platforms, enabling the firm to recognize value from market information and continue improving it.
